title: To the Horizon
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about driving to the horizon. The road is one picture that narrows to a point; beach balls roll out of the hill and grow as they come, born by blocks nobody can see. In the second level a finish arch grows closer until the barred door opens. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change when the balls come.

box.tagline: Over the hill and far away.
box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie stands on a road that runs to the horizon. Beach balls roll out of the hill and grow as they come, then a finish arch draws near and the barred door opens. The road is one picture; the balls and the arch are blocks and timers. Play, then open the game in Game-Maker and change the timetable.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A road in perspective, painted once and cut into blocks
Blocks you cannot see give birth to the balls
Made to be copied and taken apart
